scan_semantics: At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.
safety_priority: New fault edge reannunciates before Ack
Reset only clears when Fault is absent

formal_properties.explanation: Horn follows the latched acknowledgment state.
A present fault cannot be reset away.
Every new event annunciates despite simultaneous Ack.
Fault disappearance does not clear the visible alarm.

atomic_propositions.Fault: Current fault condition Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Ack: Acknowledge horn Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Reset: Clear a removed fault Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Alarm: Latched visible alarm Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Acknowledged: Alarm acknowledged Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Horn: Unacknowledged alarm horn Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.first: True only on the first invocation after resetting the FB instance.
